# A USD invoice overpaid into an HKD bank, in a CAD-base book.
#
# Three currencies meet in one settlement entry. The invoice carries 100.00 USD
# at the 1.40 it was booked at; the customer sent 1,560.00 HKD, worth 268.32 CAD
# at 0.172; and 200.00 USD of receivable is cleared by it, so 100.00 USD more
# than the document is owed and stays behind as a credit.
#
# What the credit is worth is the question this shape asks. It was not received
# at the invoice's rate — nothing about 1.40 was paid — it was received at what
# the payment converted at, which is the bank's whole figure over everything it
# paid for: 268.32 CAD for 200.00 USD, so 1.3416, and the 100.00 USD left over
# stands at 134.16 CAD.
#
# What this fixture produces:
#
#   Assets:Bank:HKD              1,560.00 HKD   value  268.32 CAD
#   A/R USD    -100.00 USD                      value -140.00 CAD  (the invoice)
#   A/R USD    -100.00 USD                      value -134.16 CAD  (the credit)
#   Income:FX Gain                                       5.84 CAD  ($residual$)
#
# and no Imbalance split. The whole 5.84 belongs to the invoice — settled at
# 1.3416 against the 1.40 it was booked at — and none of it to the credit, which
# is carried at what it cost. Valuing the credit at 1.40 instead would report
# 11.68 realized and hand the customer a credit worth 5.84 CAD more than the
# money that arrived.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_settling_into_a_third_currency.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable USD
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:HKD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-US"
	name: "US Customer"
	currency: USD

invoice "INV-USD-OVER-HKD"
	customer_id: "C-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-USD-OVER-HKD"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 200
		account: "Assets:Bank:HKD"
		settled_amount: 1560.00
		prepayment: 100
		memo: "Payment for INV-USD-OVER-HKD"
		Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
